prompt: Game VFX concept art, Diablo IV / Path of Exile 2 quality, high three-quarter isometric ARPG camera looking down on a dark misty oak forest moor at dusk. A hooded northern ranger in a crimson hood and wolf-fur cowl, dark leather, a carved recurve bow, has just released a fire arrow: his whole body leans into the follow-through, back foot planted, bow arm extended, string hand flung back past his ear, cloak whipping. At the bow, a burst of embers and a ring of heat-distorted air. The arrow streaks across the frame toward three hulking undead ghouls, lighting the grass, stones and fog beneath its path with warm moving light, and pierces straight through the first ghoul in a spray of sparks and burning fragments, leaving it alight. The projectile: a white-hot arrowhead core with a blue-white tip, wrapped in layered spiralling flame that grades from gold to deep orange to crimson, a long tapering ribbon trail of fire that breaks into curling dark violet-black smoke and drifting embers, faint heat shimmer behind it, a scorched glowing streak burned into the ground along its path. Professional layered particle effects, volumetric light, no flat colours.
